purpose: Define a bounded declarative client-surface vocabulary for policy-filtered extension workspaces without arbitrary Dart, script, template, route, URL, handler, expression or credential execution.
security_invariants: Core admission proves owner namespacing, schema validity, reference integrity and bounded counts before activation commits.
Core serves only policy-visible contributions for the exact authenticated site, organization and workspace context.
A client manifest contains no arbitrary HTTP path, URL, executable code, template, expression, handler or credential.
The SDK validates the closed manifest schema again before exposing immutable wire-level contract models.
Unknown required vocabulary fails the affected surface closed instead of being ignored.
Capability strings and presentation hints never replace server authorization or validation.
Cached manifests bind trusted runtime, owner, authority and referenced definition generations.
Disable, uninstall, trust loss, context change and generation change invalidate the effective manifest.
All labels are plain text and all referenced data remains subject to field and row disclosure policy.
Anonymous public presentation is outside this authenticated contract and requires a separate adopted public-site contract.
